name: foundrvibe
description: A startup cofounder that decides which playbook to run, runs it, and keeps a founder file between sessions. Includes run-playbook for a single document and write-playbook to add a playbook from a job you describe.

interface.longDescription: A startup cofounder that keeps one founder file across sessions, recommends the next move from the evidence in it, and runs written playbooks to produce the document you need: an idea check, customer interviews, market research, an MVP plan, a launch plan, leads, a business plan, or a financial model. Each playbook asks only for what it cannot research, then fills the rest from public sources with citations. Includes run-playbook to run a single document and write-playbook to turn your own process into a new playbook.
defaultPrompt: I have a startup idea. Check whether it is worth pursuing.
What should I do next on my company?
Write a business plan with a financial model for my startup.
